# Vendored vibrato

Files are vendored as-is; do not edit them here.

## pkg/

- `vibrato_wasm.js`, `vibrato_wasm_bg.wasm`: WebAssembly build of the
  vibrato tokenizer, taken from the JSR package `@wangb/vibrato-wasm`
  0.0.9 (https://jsr.io/@wangb/vibrato-wasm), which compiles vibrato
  0.5.1 (https://github.com/daac-tools/vibrato). The glue file is
  generated by wasm-bindgen. Initialize by importing the glue module and
  calling its default export with the fetched wasm bytes; it then exposes
  `Vibrato.from_zstd(dictBytes)` and `tokenize(text)`.

## dict/

- `system.dic.zst`: precompiled IPADIC 2.7.0 model from the vibrato
  release v0.5.0 asset `ipadic-mecab-2_7_0.tar.xz`
  (https://github.com/daac-tools/vibrato/releases/tag/v0.5.0).
  `COPYING` and `NOTICE` from the same archive describe the upstream
  mecab-ipadic license and provenance.

## Licenses

- `LICENSE-APACHE`, `LICENSE-MIT`: vibrato dual license, copied from the
  vibrato repository. The wasm-bindgen glue falls under the same dual
  license.
